data.name: Faculty of Engineering and Technology
data.tagLine: Innovating the Future with Engineering Excellence
data.about: The Faculty of Engineering and Technology at SRM IST Tiruchirappalli offers world-class education in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security, Electronics, and Biotechnology. With state-of-the-art laboratories, industry partnerships, and research-driven pedagogy, students are groomed into globally competent engineers.
data.description: Offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral degrees with industry-integrated curricula, international exposure, and exceptional placement records.

data.name: Faculty of Management
data.about: Faculty of Management provides holistic management education emphasizing entrepreneurship, strategic leadership, financial analytics, and global supply chains. Programs include BBA and MBA with dual specializations.
data.description: Equipping future managers with case-study methods, corporate internships, and live market projects.

data.name: Institute of Hotel Management
data.tagLine: Excellence in Global Hospitality & Culinary Arts
data.about: SRM Institute of Hotel Management in Trichy is renowned for producing top hospitality professionals, chefs, and luxury resort managers with hands-on training in commercial kitchens and guest suites.
data.description: Comprehensive programs in Hotel Management and Catering Technology with worldwide hotel chain partnerships.

data.name: College of Physiotherapy
data.about: The College of Physiotherapy offers BPT and MPT programs with rigorous clinical postings at multi-specialty hospitals, sports rehabilitation centers, and neurological clinics.
data.description: Advanced training in biomechanics, kinesiology, cardiovascular rehabilitation, and pediatric physiotherapy.

data.name: College of Occupational Therapy
data.about: College of Occupational Therapy trains healthcare specialists in sensory integration, mental health therapy, assistive technology, and ergonomic design.
data.description: Offers Bachelor of Occupational Therapy (BOT) and Master of Occupational Therapy (MOT) with cutting-edge sensory labs.

data.name: Allied Health Sciences
data.about: The College of Allied Health Sciences offers specialized degrees in Medical Laboratory Technology, Cardiac Care, Radiology & Imaging, and Operation Theatre Technology.
data.description: High-demand clinical sciences with direct hospital rotations and advanced diagnostic exposure.

data.name: Science & Humanities
data.tagLine: Foundation of Scientific Inquiry & Human Values
data.about: School of Science and Humanities fosters critical thinking, scientific curiosity, and communication through undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Computer Applications (BCA), Commerce (B.Com), Mathematics, and English.
data.description: Strong foundational courses supporting technology and research initiatives.
